request.subject: CITY:GOBLIN:1

layers.text: Change only the colours and the flag: the red tents become dull mid-brown patched hide tents (#955627, shadows #562a0c) with darker stitched patches; remove the red flag so the lookout pole is bare; the pale grey hut becomes rusted iron sheets (#8a4a2a) and dull gunmetal scrap with a dark brown plank door; no red left. Keep every building's shape and place, the lookout pole, the size, black outline and art style exactly the same.
